study_note: baseline, XQC UTD 1. One of six paired-seed exploratory Humanoid Walk state backbones (seed 55, 500,000 decisions / 1,000,000 raw environment steps). Retains the established 1M-decision backbone recipe except decision budget, XQC update ratio, explicit 1M-row replay capacity, and identity. Persistent stochastic XQC collection; no inner adaptation or online evaluation. TOLD updates once; additional XQC slots use fresh replay and detached recurrent latents. Shared auxiliary representation gradients enter only in the joint update. Retain all 20 portable checkpoints every 25,000 decisions plus checkpoint-matched raw replay archives. This is not confirmatory evidence or exact trainer resume.
